description.content:
HustleHub+ Part 2 API Test Suite

This collection performs repeatable automated testing of the  
HustleHub+ MERN backend.

Coverage includes:

- Registration and authentication
    
- JWT authentication
    
- Role-Based Access Control
    
- Gig CRUD and ownership
    
- Client bookings
    
- Automatic transaction creation
    
- Booking ownership
    
- Client and Freelancer transaction access
    
- Freelancer income and estimated tax
    
- NoSQL injection protection
    
- Prototype-pollution protection
    
- XSS sanitisation
    
- Request-size limits
    
- Content-Type enforcement
    
- Security headers
    
- CORS
    

The 00 - Setup folder generates unique test users and clears  
runtime variables before each complete test run.

assertions.assertion: Sensitive password fields are not exposed
